title: Granada done well
text: Enrique was an excellent guide, good sense of  humour, very knowledgeable
author: Richard T

title: Fabulous full day trip to Alhambra Palace
text: Wonderful day trip to see Beautiful Alhambra Palace.  The journey was in a clean comfortable air conditioned vehicle driven by a friendly competent driver.  The tour guide at Alhambra was also very friendly and knowledgeable
author: llyn2016

title: A wonderful day at the Alhambra
text: We spent the day with the Discovering Spain team. Picked up in Malaga in a small comfortable van, driven to Granada  for a break to walk around for an hour and then to the Alhambra. Everything was perfect our driver couldn’t have been nicer, spoke excellent English, our tour guide fantastic and the whole thing was exactly on time. I was expecting a large impersonal tour, but the whole experience was small, personal and very enjoyable. Thank you DS team!!
author: brentbR76JP

title: Thank you!
text: We were very pleased with the taxi service of David. He picked us up from the location and drove us to the Granada, as a complimentary personal escort. The trip was nice and comfortable,and we enjoyed the conversation with David, while in the taxi. We were also impressed  by the tour agent Lily, who provided us with all kinds of information and tips, and was super kind and friendly.
author: Bojana M
